decision: Rejected: additional cross-runtime decode handoffs regress isolated and shared point latency; execution sources restored.

scope.defaults: No file cache; Foyer and scheduler use cache/node initialization runtime (10 workers locally); caller has Tokio-default 10 workers. Coalescing remains enabled for this experiment.
scope.overlay: No file cache; Foyer on node runtime (10); caller on 8 workers as q18-read-path.toml actor setting; scheduler dedicated runtime has 2 workers.
scope.same: Cache and caller on the same 8-worker runtime; scheduler dedicated runtime has 2 workers. Identity fast-path control.
scope.limitation: Runtime topology reproduces relevant RW construction semantics using the SST fixture; not a full compute-server/SQL/S3/disk-cache deployment. macOS ARM64 debug, in-memory backend with 0 or 2000us Tokio timer. No concurrent compile/profiler/TRACE during measurements.
scope.shared_fixture: Test-only backend completion gate holds all reads until point has registered against an already registered scan producer; then released before waiting for point. Asserts need_await and exactly 64 outer producers. The exploratory ungated fixture hit a registration-timing assertion on baseline; those samples are excluded.
scope.sampling: 3 alternating-order rounds, 20 warmups and 300 measured samples per arm/case/round. Each cold16 round has 300 16-block windows. Displayed p50/p99 are medians of per-round percentiles, not pooled percentiles.
